Company description: GILD (Generated via gemini-3.1-flash-lite)

Gilead Sciences, Inc. is a research-based biopharmaceutical company that discovers, develops, and commercializes innovative medicines in areas of high unmet medical need. Headquartered in Foster City, California, the company focuses primarily on antiviral therapies, including groundbreaking treatments for HIV, hepatitis B, and hepatitis C. In recent years, Gilead has significantly expanded its portfolio into oncology and inflammatory diseases through strategic acquisitions and internal research.

Founded in 1987 by Michael Riordan, the company initially focused on antiviral technology. It gained global prominence in the 1990s and 2000s for its development of foundational HIV medications, such as Viread, which transformed the management of the virus from a terminal diagnosis into a manageable chronic condition. Gilead later revolutionized the treatment of hepatitis C with the introduction of Sovaldi and Harvoni, which offered the first high-cure-rate regimens for the disease. Today, Gilead continues to leverage its expertise in immunology and virology to address complex global health challenges, maintaining a robust pipeline of therapies aimed at improving patient outcomes worldwide.
